CustomField.description: Replace (default): the field just overwrites the current value on the target record, as always. Historize: in addition to that, every apply also inserts a row on the mapped history object so the value can be charted over time in native Reports (e.g. église attendance/membership). History_Only: no field on the target record at all — the value only becomes a new row on the mapped history object, linked to the target record; Field_API_Name__c then holds the virtual key HistoryObject.ValueField. History_Table: a paste-from-Excel table on the public form (églises) — each pasted line becomes one row on the mapped history object; Field_API_Name__c holds the virtual key HistoryObject#table and History_Table_Columns__c the checked columns.
CustomField.label: History Mode
